transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Just... tired, I guess. I'm just so worn out. Even getting up, um... walking from the bedroom to the kitchen... it feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And resting doesn't... it doesn't give me anything back. So... that's what brought me in.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah... I suppose. It's just... I wake up and there's this heavy... hopeless feeling in my chest. Um... some days I just end up out in the garage. Just sitting there, crying... and I don't even really know what started it. It's just... there.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About... four months, I guess. Since my wife went back to working full-time. I just... I spend most of the weekdays alone now. So... yeah. Around then.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling this way?

No. Not really. I used to... I liked singing in the choir, playing pickup ball... working on cars. Grilling on the weekends. But now... I just can't make myself care. I don't even answer texts when people ask where I am. I just... don't want to do any of it.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

I don't know... I guess so. I just... I think about how I've failed everybody. My wife... my kids. The church. It just feels like... I don't know. Like maybe everything going wrong lately is... is some kind of punishment. Because I'm not... I'm not the man I should have been for them.
Have you had thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?

I... I don't really want to talk about that. But... yeah. The thought just... it keeps coming. That I should just be dead. And... when I'm here by myself all day, it... it scares me. Because I start thinking I might actually... do something. To make it happen.
Do you find yourself moving or speaking more slowly than you used to, or have people told you that you seem slowed down?

I guess... yeah. My wife mentioned it. I just... it feels like I'm moving through mud. Every little thing takes so much effort. And... when someone asks me something, I hear them, but... it's like I can't find the words. It just takes a long time to get them out.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety lately?
No, not really. It's... like I just said. I'm just slow. I don't have the energy to be restless. It's just the mud. Everything is just... heavy.
Have you had any periods in the last four months where you felt significantly better for a few days or more?
No. I haven't. It's just been... the same. Every day.
Have you had any days in the past four months where you felt almost back to normal?
I... no. Like I just said. It doesn't let up. There's no normal anymore.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

No. I used to... do things. Choir. Pickup ball. Working on cars, grilling for the family... stuff like that. But... no. I just can't make myself care enough to show up anymore. I don't even answer their texts. There's just... nothing.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear?

I... guess so. I don't really like talking about it. But... yeah. When my wife is at work. The house gets real quiet, and... I hear them. It sounds just like somebody is standing right out in the hallway. Telling me... telling me I'm a burden. That my family would just be better off without me.
Have you been having these voices or strange thoughts every day for the past four months?

I... suppose so. Most days. I just... I never heard things before. Or thought I was being punished. Not back when I was myself. It really only started after... after I sank into this depression. When I just... stopped keeping up with my life.
Have you been feeling anxious or agitated, like you can't sit still?
No... I don't think so. I mostly just... sit there. I don't really move around much.
Are the voices you hear something that you can ignore or do they tell you to do things?
I... I don't know. They just... they just say those things. I try to block them out, but... they don't really tell me to do anything. Just... talk.
Have you had any difficulty with concentration or making decisions?
I don't... I haven't really noticed. There isn't much I need to concentrate on these days. And... I don't really make decisions anymore. So... I guess not.
Have you had any periods where these voices told you to harm yourself?

Not... not the voices, no. But... the thought just keeps coming up. That I should... just be dead. It... it scares me sometimes, when I'm alone. I start thinking I might... actually do something. To make that happen.
Are the voices you hear something that you believe are real, or do you know they are just a product of your own mind?
I... I don't know. They sound real. They sound like... someone is right there. I don't... I don't know where they come from.
Do you think the voices you hear are coming from inside your mind or from somewhere outside of you?

I... outside, I think. When my wife is at work and... and the house is quiet... it's clear as somebody standing right there in the hallway. Just... telling me I'm a burden. That my family would be better off without me.
Have you had any periods in the last four months where you felt better for at least two weeks?
No... I don't think so. It just... stays like this. I haven't really had any good weeks.
